hypotheses.title: Subindustry Low-Beta Anomaly with Idiosyncratic Risk Dampening
hypotheses.economic_rationale: The Low-Beta / Low-Volatility anomaly is one of the most robust asset pricing phenomena: retail leverage constraints and institutional tracking error mandates systematically inflate high-beta equities, leading to negative alpha. Within subindustries, low-beta firms with low idiosyncratic volatility compound superior risk-adjusted returns while providing smooth portfolio diversification with zero weight concentration.
confounders: Speculative bull rallies where high-beta junk stocks temporarily outperform quality compounders
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high-beta stocks consistently outperform low-beta peers within subindustries.

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Customer Return Shock Spillover with Linear Decay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Customer return shocks propagate to suppliers over a 10-day window due to gradual supply-chain information diffusion. Using the platform-supported linear decay operator ts_decay_linear combined with subindustry neutralization and quiet trading volume weighting isolates institutional under-reaction in neglected suppliers.
confounders: Supplier contract cancellations rendering historical customer return signals irrelevant
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if customer shocks are already instantaneous and fully priced on Day 0.

hypotheses.title: Options Put/Call Open Interest Sentiment and Cycle Extrema Timing (Bounded)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 231, this exact signal combination achieved a positive Sub-Universe Sharpe of +0.37 and 28.58% turnover, but failed weight concentration because of unbounded z-score cross-multiplication. Replacing the product with a bounded convex rank combination strictly distributes capital across all 3,000 instruments, eliminating weight concentration while preserving the predictive power of options contrarian sentiment and cyclical low timing.
confounders: Prolonged structural bear trends where put open interest continues rising without recovery
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high put open interest accurately predicts further price collapse rather than a contrarian bottom.
